posts.name: Ten
posts.cooked:
I have come across articles on the internet that highlight how great Artificial Intelligence is and how it can act as fake players/bots to appear to be real players. Allowing game companies to fill mmorpgs with these A.I. bots to convince real players that the mmorpg still has high numbers of real players while the reality is the population has been declining substantially.

I kinda laughed at first. Thinking this to be ridiculous. But then I started thinking about how in WoW and some of the other mmorpg games I play these days, real players no longer talk to each other. When I’ve been in a dungeon group, it’s complete silence. Even when I say hello, hows everyone doing. I get silence. I might occasionally get back a “Hi” and sometimes at the end of a dungeon run I might see a written “gg”. But what little rare player banter there is sounds canned.

Then I thought about Follower Dungeons. Those NPC companions sometimes act better than real players. To be honest they are more responsive than real players. So how hard would it be to fill the game with fake players. I mean like while you run around in the game world you really don’t talk to anyone. And dungeons are silent. You don’t even see the toxic crowd yelling at others anymore.

So is there a possibility that a lot of the players we see running around in WoW are not real players any more, but A.I. controlled NPC bots. Even when you speak to them they could reply semi-intelligently? I am getting real Stepford Wives vibes. Lol.
